content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was that unit tests were using uppercase key names when interacting with the Key Management Server (KMS) which caused mismatches with the expected lowercase key names. This inconsistency in key naming conventions led to failures in the tests, as the KMS implementation likely treated uppercase and lowercase keys as distinct, resulting in unauthorized access or key not found errors during the test executions. The patch corrected these uppercase key names to the expected lowercase format, thereby ensuring that the tests could successfully pass without authorization issues.
